advisor_identified: Richard James Storr, historian of higher education; University of Chicago, then York University History Department from 1968 until retirement in 1982.

evidence.says: York University Archives identifies Richard James Storr, states that he received his PhD from Harvard University in 1949, and records his appointment to York history in 1968 and retirement in 1982.
The Bowdoin Orient, June 18, 1949, page 1, reports that Richard J. Storr had received an earned PhD in History at Harvard and was being promoted to Assistant Professor of American History.

notes: The independently documented institution, year, subject and name match linked AHA record 56195. The dissertation title was not independently verified; title is therefore null.
